figurative_meaning_en: A dry heart; a nearly lifeless person
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জীবন জলহীন জলাশয়ের মতো শুষ্ক হয়ে গেছে।
এই বয়সে সে জলহীন জলাশয়ের মতো মৃতপ্রায়।
example_sentences_in_english: His life has become as dry as a waterless reservoir.
At this age, he is nearly lifeless like a waterless pond.
note: The idiom evokes imagery of drought or emptiness in rural water sources, common in Bengali literature.
